write_behavior: none; every command emits canonical JSON to stdout and only the root controller persists create-only bytes with apply_patch

schedule_authority.admission_rule: Use the exact harness-declared ordered cell list generically; no tension ID, expected answer, slot, route, or model exception may alter admission.

run_contract.candidate_freeze_sha256: required lowercase 64-hex external freeze-manifest storage identity
run_contract.sequence_two: qualification_sequence=2 and predecessor_run_id is a different valid run_id
run_contract.external_freeze_status: not yet available; this contract remains neutral and unsealed and asserts no freeze digest

execution_root.constraint: resolved contained directory strictly beneath successor_20260813

closed_world_layout.<slot>/rendered/<cell>.txt: exact harness render storage when persisted
closed_world_layout.artifact_manifest.json: pw-r8-artifact-manifest-v3 exact inventory of every final run file except itself and validation_report.json
closed_world_layout.validation_report.json: pw-r8-run-validation-v3 exact binding of reopened manifest, matrix terminal, and subject-call accounting

capture_envelope.binding: Verifier reconstructs the entire envelope from the only derived direct-appserver receipt; equality and key order are exact. The raw full final list and its digest remain present even when normalization applies.
capture_envelope.task_identity: The fresh user-visible task is the newly created thread_id. The app-server task_started and task_complete records use the single turn_id and expose no separate task_id.
capture_envelope.nonconforming_calls: Capture envelope is still required. No replacement semantic capture is admitted.

subject_output_boundary.boolean_boundary_rule: The driver and verifier never branch on preserve_boundary values, expected answers, tension IDs, routes, slots, or models; score verdict PASS or FAIL comes only from the harness.

normalization_validation.apply_predicate: count >= 2; no prohibited activity; conformance observations exactly [assistant_final_message_count_not_one]; every final is one output_text string; every UTF-8 byte string is identical
normalization_validation.closed_world_binding: Driver, verifier, capture, harness scorer, persisted score, path terminal, matrix terminal, accounting, validation report, and two-run verifier bind the normalization status and counts. Rejected normalization remains permanent FAIL.

commands.emit-capture: Derive the only legal v3 capture envelope from a completed receipt.
commands.admit: Require the exact harness-declared next cell on this slot, all earlier same-slot scores PASS, required deterministic artifacts valid, no same-slot later evidence, no same-slot path terminal, no root terminal, and only positive no-start controller invalids at target. Other-slot terminals and evidence do not block.
commands.validate-cell: Bind receipt/capture/render and invoke the harness stage scorer for authoritative permanent PASS or FAIL.
commands.validate-artifact: Recompute a deterministic stage and require byte-identical persisted storage.
commands.validate-controller-invalid: Validate a derived contiguous invalid receipt and report recreation eligibility only when every attempt at that cell has positive no-start and byte-identical frozen-input proof.
commands.path-terminal: Root-finalization command. Derive all three path terminals first and emit the selected one only if every path is already independently stopped; slot workers have no publication authority.
commands.matrix-terminal: After all three root-persisted path terminals exist, recompute them, enforce exact equality and independent task/thread/turn uniqueness, distinguish controller-invalid from subject-failure matrices, and emit exact normalization and call accounting.
commands.call-accounting: Emit exact call, outcome, normalization, invalid, ineligible, retry, replacement, and task/thread/turn identity counts.
commands.artifact-manifest: After matrix terminal and accounting are persisted, emit the exact closed-world inventory except artifact_manifest.json and validation_report.json.
commands.validation-report: After manifest persistence, reopen and bind manifest, matrix terminal, accounting, and normalization counts.
commands.reopen-matrix-terminal: After validation-report persistence, reopen/recompute the complete terminal chain.
commands.qualify-two-runs: Require sequence 1 then 2, the same external candidate freeze digest, two final-reopened complete-clean matrices, and exactly 582 fresh completed PASS calls with zero invalid, missing, ineligible, retry, best-of, or replacement counts and 582 distinct thread IDs plus 582 distinct turn IDs.

terminal_generation_order: all three independent path workers stop without publishing terminals
root runs reopen-matrix-terminal without persisting another run artifact

causal_rules.no_start_recreation: only contiguous preserved invalid receipts with subject_call_started exactly false and byte-identical frozen input

terminal_rules.clean_path: all 97 harness-declared cells completed and PASS plus byte-valid S90 bounded_causal_simulation_pass and zero controller-invalid receipts on that path
terminal_rules.failed_path: first valid subject FAIL is permanent and no later same-slot evidence may exist
terminal_rules.invalid_path: any same-slot controller-invalid receipt excludes clean path credit; other paths continue
terminal_rules.clean_matrix: three COMPLETE_PASS paths, exactly 291 completed PASS calls, zero invalid or missing evidence, exact normalization accounting, 291 unique thread IDs and 291 unique turn IDs, and clean credit exactly 1
terminal_rules.two_run_qualification: exactly two consecutive final-reopened clean matrices bound to one candidate freeze digest, 582 completed PASS calls, and 582 unique thread IDs and turn IDs
terminal_rules.invalid_matrix: any controller-invalid history has clean credit 0 and a controller-invalid matrix label, mixed only when valid subject FAIL evidence also exists
terminal_rules.failed_matrix: with zero controller invalids, valid honest terminal with exact calls, PASS, FAIL, normalization, ineligible, and zero retry/best-of/replacement accounting

nonclaims: This verifier is disposable and not a production security boundary.
A valid terminal applies only to the frozen throwaway fixture and candidate bytes.
One clean matrix is not two-run qualification.
Unsealed contracts are not authority to launch subjects or assert a freeze identity.
